# H A V N & COMPANY (AGA Associates)

> Leading Chartered Accountant (CA) firm in Nabha / Patiala, Punjab and across India. Providing expert services in Tax Planning, Audit & Assurance, Corporate Compliance, NRI Financial Advisory, Company Formation, Bank Financing, and Business Software Consultancy.

## Attestation, Audit & Assurance Services
- [Audit & Assurance Overview](https://www.agaassociates.com/attestation-audit-assurance/): Comprehensive statutory, internal, and specialized audit solutions.
- [Statutory Audit](https://www.agaassociates.com/attestation-audit-assurance/statutory-audit/): Statutory financial audits under the Companies Act and statutory regulations.
- [Internal Audit](https://www.agaassociates.com/attestation-audit-assurance/internal-audit/): Operational risk management, internal controls review, and governance audits.
- [Concurrent Audit](https://www.agaassociates.com/attestation-audit-assurance/concurrent-audit/): Real-time transaction verification for banks, financial institutions, and enterprises.
- [Compliance Audit](https://www.agaassociates.com/attestation-audit-assurance/compliance-audit/): Regulatory, labor, and corporate statutory compliance audits.
- [Inventory Audit](https://www.agaassociates.com/attestation-audit-assurance/inventory-audit/): Physical stock verification, inventory valuation, and asset reconciliation.
- [Investigative Audit](https://www.agaassociates.com/attestation-audit-assurance/investigative-audit/): Forensic auditing, fraud investigation, and special financial reviews.
- [Payroll Audit](https://www.agaassociates.com/attestation-audit-assurance/payroll-audit/): Verification of employee compensation, PF/ESI compliance, and tax withholding.
- [Revenue Audit](https://www.agaassociates.com/attestation-audit-assurance/revenue-audit/): Revenue leakage assessment, income verification, and financial leak analysis.

## Registration & Incorporation Services
- [Registration Services Overview](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/): Business entity setup, government registrations, and licensing.
- [Company Incorporation Services](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/company-incorporation-services/): Complete assistance for forming new businesses in India.
- [Private Company Registration](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/private-company-registration/): Private Limited Company incorporation and ROC approval.
- [Setting Up Company](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/setting-up-company/): End-to-end corporate setup and statutory structuring.
- [Partnership Firm Registration](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/partnership-firm-registration/): Partnership deed drafting and Registrar of Firms registration.
- [HUF Registration](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/huf-registration/): Hindu Undivided Family formation and tax entity creation.
- [Society Registration](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/society-registration/): Non-profit and NGO society registration under Societies Registration Act.
- [GST Registration](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/gst-registration/): Goods and Services Tax registration and GSTIN issuance.
- [Trademark Registration](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/trademark-registration/): Intellectual property and brand logo/name registration.
- [FSSAI License Registration](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/fssai-license-registration/): Food safety license and FSSAI business registration.
- [GeM Registration](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/gem-registration/): Government e-Marketplace vendor portal registration.
- [NITI Aayog / Udyog Registration](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/niti-udyog-registration/): NGO Darpan / NITI Aayog portal listing and MSME Udyam registration.
- [PAN Application](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/pan-application/): Permanent Account Number issuance for individuals, firms, and companies.
- [Start Up Certificate](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/start-up-certificate/): DPIIT Startup India recognition and tax exemption certification.
- [Shop Act Registration](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/shop-act-registration/): Shop and Commercial Establishment Act licensing.
- [Registration for Jewellers](https://www.agaassociates.com/registration-services/registration-for-jewellers/): BIS Hallmark registration and specialized compliance for jewelers.

## Other Consultancy Services
- [Company Formation](https://www.agaassociates.com/other-consultancy-services/company-formation/): Formation and structure optimization of LLPs, OPCs, and corporate entities.
- [Bank Loan and Finance Services](https://www.agaassociates.com/other-consultancy-services/bank-loan-and-finance-services/): Project finance, working capital loans, CMA data preparation, and loan syndication.
- [Financial Advisory Services](https://www.agaassociates.com/other-consultancy-services/financial-advisory-services/): Corporate restructuring, capital planning, risk assessment, valuation, and wealth management.
- [NRI Services & ITR of NRI](https://www.agaassociates.com/other-consultancy-services/nri-services-itr-of-nri/): Non-Resident Indian tax filing, FEMA compliance, 15CA & 15CB certifications, foreign asset reporting, and repatriation advice.
- [Business Software Consultancy](https://www.agaassociates.com/other-consultancy-services/business-software-consultancy/): Implementation, setup, and support for accounting software (Tally, Zoho Books, ERP) and compliance automation tools.
